**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Battle of El Fasher]]
****The Ministry of Health of [[North Darfur]] reports that there has been 82 deaths and hundreds of injuries due to clashes in [[Al-Fashir|El Fasher]] over the last two days. [https://sudantribune.com/article286519/ (Sudan Tribune)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Mexican general election]]
**[[Mexicans]] elect a new [[president of Mexico|president]] and [[Congress of the Union|legislature]], [[List of current state governors in Mexico|eight governors]], the [[mayor of Mexico City]], and around 20,000 other positions in [[2024 Mexican general election|federal]] and [[2024 Mexican local elections|local elections]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/01/americas/mexico-election-explainer-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Claudia Sheinbaum]] wins the presidential election. She will begin her term as [[Mexico]]'s first [[List of elected and appointed female heads of state and government|female]] president on October 1. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/mexico-election-violence-1.7222446 (CBC)]
*[[2024 Iranian presidential election]]
**Former [[president of Iran]] [[Mahmoud Ahmadinejad]] announces that he intends to run again following the [[2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash|death]] of [[Ebrahim Raisi]]. Ahmadinejad has been rejected from running in the two previous presidential elections. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-06-02/mahmoud-ahmadinejad-registers-iranian-election-helicopter-crash/103925472 (ABC News Australia)]
